Want to suggest a guest?
Sarthak Goswami is a Delhi-based news and entertainment creator who covered the CJP protest from inside it — days on the ground, through the lathi charge and a barricaded crowd that came close to a stampede. He came up making satire out of Indian political news, and his documentary on the protest put him inside the story he was there to report. Blunt about the media he came up in, honest about the protest's own contradictions, and done with the myth-making on every side.
